notes.title: Aria Disconnect Demo is available now!
notes.notes:
Hi my fellow wishlister and others!

Finally i have a demo build of Aria Disconnect available on steam and i just wanted to notify you about this.

I hope you will enjoy Aria Disconnect as much as ive enjoyed developing it!

Remember that this is a demo, so bugs are apparent and a lot of stuff is a subject for change.

Have fun!

//Kimmo
